description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as invoice code, payer name, invoice number, total amount, and payee name
description_zh: 支持包括票据代码、交款人、票据号码、合计金额、收款单位等关键字段结构化识别输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-non-tax-invoice --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241223/bsrdwj/%E9%9D%9E%E7%A8%8E%E6%94%B6%E5%85%A5%E5%8F%91%E7%A5%A8%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeNonTaxInvoice

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one of them, and cannot pass through both or leave both empty.
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; Base64 encoding is not supported)
parameters.help_zh:
* 本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one of them, and cannot pass through both or leave both empty.
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB.
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file of the image in the HTTP body.
* When invoking via software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body
parameters.help_zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body
